title: Cultist's Fervor/Skill history
wikitext:
{{Skill history}}

== January 28, 2010 ==
* Increased [[recharge time]] to 25 seconds.
* Changed [[duration]] to 5 seconds plus 3 seconds for every [[rank]] of [[Soul Reaping]].
* Decreased [[Energy]] cost reduction to {{gr|1|6}}.
